sections.description: One-click, six-hour administrator access to registered WordPress abilities through the official MCP Adapter.
sections.changelog:
0.1.0

  • Temporary MCP access with credential rotation, six-hour expiry, and automatic adapter setup.
  • 23 native admin abilities for content, accounts, settings, media, navigation, templates, plugins, themes, and updates, without direct file-editing tools.
  • Registered abilities inventory with source attribution and modal inspection.
